yakit.AutoInitYakit() ip = cli.String("ip") url = str.f("http://ip.yqie.com/ipwhois.aspx?searchword=%v", ip) rsp, err = http.Get(url, http.header("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/104.0.0.0 Safari/537.36")) if err != nil { yakit.Error(string(err)) return } rspraw, dumperr = http.dump(rsp) if dumperr != nil { yakit.Error(string(dumperr)) return } header, body = str.SplitHTTPHeadersAndBodyFromPacket(rspraw) script, xerr = xpath.LoadHTMLDocument(body) if xerr != nil { yakit.Error(string(xerr)) return } atob = xpath.FindOne(script, `//*[@id="page"]/div[8]/div[3]/script`) b = xpath.InnerText(atob)[28:] i = len(b) - 4 index = b[:i] breport, xrerr = codec.DecodeBase64(index) report = re.ReplaceAll(string(breport), "
", "\r\n") yakit.Text(report)
